items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html: The place of Yetzirah was made from the discernment of the ZA of the body, which was darkened and went out below the conclusion of Atzilut, at the time of the ascent of the concluding Malchut to the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG, which is called the externality from the side of the back. See above, answer 97. Therefore Yetzirah is considered the back of the ZA of Atzilut. And at the time of the first correction of BYA, when they were corrected from the discernment of the front of the backs of the seven dead kings, the world of Yetzirah was already in the place of the ZA of Atzilut, being its back. And after the sin it descended with a great descent, because the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah clothed themselves within the dwelling place of the Klipot. And the Mochin that it receives come out upon a screen of phase one, which is the screen of ZA from the discernment of VAK without a head. And the five Partzufim of the world of Yetzirah are in the level of the middle thirds and the lower thirds of the NHY of AA, which are also the discernment of the externality from the side of the back, like the place of Yetzirah, because the upper thirds of the NHY of AA, which are the discernment of the externality from the side of the front, were clothed only in the world of Beriah, and they are the discernment of the GAR of the NHY that are lacking in Yetzirah. And these two lower parts of the NHY of AA clothe in the VAK of the VAK of the upper AVI, and they are the VAK of YESHSUT, and they are the VAK of ZON. (Item 5, Item 83, Item 93, and Items 224 to 228).
